column1: Hey! Whassa matter, is your radar down, or are you just starved for human contact?
column2: 嘿！怎麼了，你的雷達壞了，還是只是太渴望和人接觸？

column1: Get real, Sonny! Slamdancing went out with mohawks and safety pins through the nose.
column2: 醒醒吧，Sonny！剃莫霍克頭、把安全別針穿進鼻子的年代早過去了。

column1: Hey! I'm not into full contact sports. I was on the varsity golf team in high school, man!
column2: 嘿！我不喜歡全接觸運動。老兄，我高中可是校隊高爾夫球員！

column1: Wake up, Sonny! What's the matter, those seven donuts and four cups of coffee haven't kicked in yet?
column2: 醒醒，Sonny！怎麼了，七個甜甜圈和四杯咖啡還沒發揮作用嗎？

column1: Hey! You got chocolate in my peanut butter! Ha ha ha ha!
column2: 嘿！你把巧克力弄到我的花生醬裡了！哈哈哈哈！

column1: Hey! What's with you, Bonds, were you up a little too late last night? Nah, that would mean you had a social life!
column2: 嘿！你怎麼回事，Bonds，昨晚是不是太晚睡？不，那表示你得先有社交生活！

column1: Oh, Master Bonds! Hello! I know you had to pass a minimal IQ test to get this job, get a clue and sit your butt down!
column2: 哦，Bonds 大師！你好！我知道你只要通過最低智力測驗就能得到這份工作，識相點，坐下！
喂——！愛因斯坦先生！Sonny——椅子——現在坐下！
好啦，屁孩，你被趕出去了！

column1: Steve doesn't want to play now.
Hmm, a little dust in there, but nothing else.
column2: 嗯，裡面有一點灰塵，但沒有別的東西。

column1: It's your pigeonhole. It looks like there's a hand-written note inside.
column2: 這是你的信箱。裡面好像有一張手寫便條。

column1: The tables seem to be held in place by waxy buildup. No sense in messing with them.
column2: 桌子似乎被蠟狀堆積物固定住了。沒必要去動它們。

column1: This is the briefing room. Each shift begins with a briefing.
column2: 這是簡報室。每一班勤務都從簡報開始。

column1: What are you going to do, guess the paper's age by counting the coffee rings?
column2: 你打算怎麼做，數咖啡杯印來猜報紙的年紀嗎？

column1: Perhaps the Sergeant was trying to protect the fine finish of the cabinet by covering it with departmental paperwork.
column2: 也許警佐是想用警局文件蓋住櫃子，保護它精美的表面。
